$schema: uinaf component contract v1 — one entry per pattern; markup is canonical, rules carry the WHY (agents ignore whats without whys)
$css: tokens.css auto-imports components.css; import one file (@uinaf/design/css)

patterns.name: banner
patterns.use: one-line site-wide notice pinned above the topbar — a deprecation, a migration date, a status link
patterns.markup: scheduled maintenance 02:00–03:00 UTC status ↗
rules: a single centred line, hairline rule underneath, muted at 11px
sits above the topbar and scrolls away with the page
never: a filled color band, an icon, or a dismiss ✕ — that is a notice, not a banner
stacking two of them

patterns.name: breadcrumbs
patterns.use: path with / separators
patterns.markup: uinaf/slopzapper/runs
rules: current page brightest

patterns.name: button
patterns.use: 32px rhythm (26/38 sm/lg), 13px lowercase labels
patterns.markup:
<button type="button" class="u-btn u-btn--primary">save</button>
<button type="button" class="u-btn u-btn--accent">review</button>
<button type="button" class="u-btn u-btn--ghost">cancel</button>
<button type="button" class="u-btn u-btn--sm">retry</button>
<button type="button" class="u-btn u-btn--lg u-btn--primary">get started</button>
<button type="button" class="u-btn u-btn--icon u-tip" data-tip="re-run" aria-label="re-run"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M13.5 8a5.5 5.5 0 1 1-1.6-3.9M13.5 2.5v3h-3"/></svg></button>
rules: hierarchy via fill weight: primary=white fill, secondary=outline, ghost=borderless
default pairing = primary + ghost
natural width — never stretch full-width, even in auth cards
icon-only: .u-btn--icon squares the button; data-tip + aria-label carry the word
never: two fills side by side
more than one .u-btn--accent per surface (usually zero)

patterns.name: card
patterns.use: the indexable link primitive — the WHOLE card is one link
patterns.markup:
healthd

small daemon for machine health checks and reporting.
rules: hover: border brightens + 2px lift; press compresses
never: links inside a card-link

patterns.name: charts
patterns.use: sparklines in stats · bars · line · uptime strip · stacked distribution
rules: series 1 = accent, 2+ = slime (cyan/purple/magenta/green)
bars neutral with ONE hot period
SVG for spark/line (data, not decoration); CSS for bars/dots/stack
never: chart junk: legends for one series, fills beyond the rare accent area, glows
patterns.markup:
reviews / day128
aug 03today
p50p95

patterns.name: choice
patterns.use: checkbox and radio — the only styled boolean inputs
patterns.markup:
<label class="u-check"><input type="checkbox" checked> review draft PRs</label>
<label class="u-check"><input type="radio" name="trigger" checked> on open + push</label>
rules: the box carries the accent when checked; the text stays muted
radio is the same box with a pill radius — no custom glyphs
always wrap in the label so the text is a hit target
never: a bare input without .u-check — the native control is not on-brand
a switch for anything behind a save button — see the switch pattern

patterns.name: code
patterns.use: inline chips on raised fill; blocks darker, 13px; .u-code-bleed lets a block run wider than narrow prose
rules: never wrap code — scroll it
abbreviations in code stay as written (--pr flags, url vars)

patterns.name: def-rows
patterns.use: term/description rows for metadata, specs, and settings summaries
patterns.markup:
trigger
on open + push

rules: hairline rules between rows carry the structure — the term column is fixed at 120px
the term is a micro-label; the description is body text
never: boxing the list or banding alternate rows

patterns.name: diff
patterns.use: tinted add/del lines; findings pin to their line as hairline inset panels
rules: finding = dot + bold-lead dry sentence with file/line specificity
patterns.markup:
41 const key = await deriveKey(secret);
42- cache.set(url, key);
42+ cache.set(url, key, { ttl: 300 });
unbounded cache before this change. ttl fixes growth, but eviction on key rotation is still missing — see deriveKey.
43 return key;

patterns.use: dashed region, one dry line, one action
rules: a code snippet may stand in as the action for CLI products
never: illustrations
multi-paragraph explanations

patterns.name: field
patterns.use: micro-label above a 32px control on a slightly raised fill
rules: focus brightens the border — no rings, no glow; caret is accent
errors: muted red border + one dry sentence
never: error banners
floating labels

patterns.name: footer
patterns.use: page footer: a few quiet link columns over a hairline

patterns.name: hero
patterns.use: optional kicker → 32px title ≤22ch → one 14px sub ≤46ch → primary+ghost → optional stat strip
rules: the kicker must ADD information (category, status, live stat)
never: a kicker that repeats the product name, studio name, or anything in the nav — `UINAF · REVIEW BOT` under a slopzapper nav is the canonical failure; no kicker beats a redundant one
patterns.markup:
AI code review · runs the code

PR review that actually runs the PR.

every PR gets cloned into a cloudflare sandbox, built, exercised, and reviewed. findings only, no vibes.

add to github ↗ read the docs

patterns.name: icons
patterns.use: glyphs first: ↗ · ··· ← → and .u-dot cover most needs. when a pattern genuinely requires icons, pick from the committed set (assets/icons/ — search, copy, download, refresh, file, folder, branch, warning); extend it in the set's idiom: 16-grid stroke SVG, stroke 1.5, square caps, integer/half-px coordinates, currentColor, no fills
patterns.markup: <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="4.5"/><path d="M10.5 10.5L14 14"/></svg>
rules: the set is original work, licensed with the repo — no third-party attribution needed
never import an icon library and never paste from third-party sets (lucide/feather/heroicons/geist) — extend the committed set instead, in its idiom
sizes, stroke scaling inversely: 16/1.5 default · 12/1.75 in tags+meta rows · 20/1.25 in large buttons and empty states
no icon beside a word that already says it
a new icon lands as a PR to assets/icons/ — agents pick from the set, never invent inline
never: decorative icons on buttons/nav that words already cover
two icon idioms on one surface

patterns.name: list

rules: row is one .u-link-plain when it links

patterns.name: micro-label
patterns.use: THE hierarchy device: kicks off sections, heads tables, labels fields, captions stats
patterns.markup: recent reviews new 128 runs
rules: 11px uppercase tracked dim — the only uppercase besides abbreviations
fix weak hierarchy with a micro-label + space, never with size
never: accent color except one active marker per view

patterns.name: modal
patterns.use: confirm destructive actions
rules: title / body / primary+ghost pair; cancel is a button — no ✕
overlay click + esc close; toggle via hidden attribute
the overlay carries `hidden`; the app toggles it — a copied modal must not cover the page on load

removes the app from all 12 repos. runs are kept 30 days, then deleted. reinstalling restores nothing.

patterns.name: primitives

patterns.name: progress
patterns.use: segment ticks + `2/5` count
rules: filled=neutral, accent=the segment running NOW
never: bars, percentages, spinners — progress is countable or it isn't shown

patterns.name: prose
patterns.use: long-form at narrow measure
rules: three link families, never mixed on one surface: prose (dim underline, phosphor hover) · plain chrome (opacity fade) · whole-card
patterns.markup: underline is the affordance; hover goes phosphor. write to dev@uinaf.dev or read the source ↗. the underline never disappears. a plain link drops it for chrome that already reads as a target.

patterns.name: segmented
patterns.use: 2-4 short exclusive views (7d/30d/90d)
rules: 26px bordered group; active = raised bg
aria-pressed carries state
never: actions in a segmented control

patterns.name: shell
patterns.use: narrow 40rem (default — prose, home, detail) · base 48rem (data-dense: tables, dashboards) · wide 72rem (rare) · one product = one width
rules: if unsure, narrow
never widen a shell to fit one element
one product = one width: every page keeps the same shell; a data-dense view may step UP to base, but a detail page never shrinks below its index/home

patterns.name: skeleton
patterns.use: loading placeholder shaped like the content it replaces
rules: match the real element’s height so nothing shifts when it resolves
the sheen stops under prefers-reduced-motion
never: a spinner, or a skeleton for something that loads instantly

patterns.name: stat
patterns.use: label / value / note; lives in panels or panel grids
patterns.markup: queue7PRs waiting
rules: value is 24px — same step as page titles

patterns.name: switch
patterns.use: a toggle for a setting that applies immediately, with no save step
patterns.markup: <label class="u-switch"><input type="checkbox" checked> notify on finish</label>
rules: use a switch only for instant-apply; anything behind a save button is a checkbox
never: pairing a switch with a save button

patterns.name: tooltip
patterns.use: a short clarification on hover or focus, from a data-tip attribute
patterns.markup: <button type="button" class="u-btn u-btn--sm u-tip" data-tip="re-runs against the latest commit">retry</button>
rules: CSS-only: put the text in data-tip, keep it to a few words
appears on focus-visible too, so it is reachable by keyboard
never: a tooltip carrying information the user needs to complete the task

slopzapper
